name: naranj-cafe
description: منوی دیجیتال QR و پنل مدیریت کافه — Next.js + Node.js (Express) + Prisma

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:setup -w api
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run start -w api" "npm run start -w web"
